title: The Maharashtra Mathadi, Hamal and other Manual Workers (Regulation of Employment and Welfare) Act, 1969
full_text: The Maharashtra Mathadi, Hamal and other Manual Workers (Regulation of Employment and Welfare) Act, 1969 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 196930 Act Number: 30 Enactment Date: 1969-06-13 Act Year: 1969 Short Title: The Maharashtra Mathadi, Hamal and other Manual Workers (Regulation of Employment and Welfare) Act, 1969 Long Title: An Act for regulating the employment of unprotected manual workers employed in certain employments in the State of Maharashtra, to make provision for their adequate supply and proper and full utilization in such employments, and for maters connected therewith. Short title, extent, application and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Schemes for ensuring regular employment of unprotected workers. Section 4. Making, variation and revocation of scheme. Section 5. Disputes regarding application of scheme. Section 6. Constitution of Board. Section 6A. Power of State Government to appoint Board consisting of one person. Section 7. Power and duties of Board. Section 8. Accounts and audit. Section 9. Disqualifications and removal. Section 10. Section 17C. Appeal from Labour Court to Industrial Court. Section 17D. Industrial Court under Bombay Industrial Relations Act to be Industrial Court under this Act also. Section 17E. Decision of Labour Court and Industrial Court not to be questioned in any Civil or Criminal Court. Section 17F. Cases to be disposed of by Labour Court and Industrial Court within three months. Section 17G. Other relevant provisions of Bombay Industrial Relations Act to apply and to be followed. Section 18. Application of Workmen's Compensation Act to unprotected workers. Section 19.
